reviews.text: This place is TOTALLY useless in terms of having product on display and their personnel were embarrassingly unqualified to provide any type of assistance. You will have better luck simply doing your own online research. Do not waste your time at Texas Pool Supply Frisco!
reviews.author: Frank Sobyak

reviews.text: The lady at the front counter is rude and very condescending, terrible customer service. I don't know what it is with this location but its been going downhill recently. They never have any of the products I need in stock. Will be giving SCP my business from here on out.
reviews.author: Britt Kaufmann

reviews.text:
They don't sell direct to consumers and they can't tell you who carries the product you need. Worthless!

Update: This is an excellent review. It's good for the individual consumer because they know not to bother calling and waste their time. Plus, good for the resellers knowing their business is being protected. it's a Win for both.
reviews.author: Lisa Hernandez

reviews.text: Nothing but great things. Called at 645 for quotes on 2 products no issues. My point is don’t go off by certain reviews to deter you from this place. Bought a filter from them installed the filter bottom blew out and  the exchange was easy. and someone answered the phone and always has. Even when opened at 630. Don’t go by, they didn’t answer phone to push you away from this company. Maybe the call went unanswered cause of short staff or call ins or they were busy at that time. Hard to keep people in business nowadays. Company is great and fast.
reviews.author: Jim Jones

reviews.text: The 2 locations I've been to Frisco and Plano are top of the line service and attitudes. Will McGrath in fricoband Brad in Frisco are the best Heather and Jim in Plano counter sales are also absolutely awesome. Love these locations.
reviews.author: Randy Mooneyham

reviews.text:
I have been buying products from this company for 1 year, yesterday I was surprised that I am prohibited from buying products from the Hayward brand, I had already placed the order online, when I picked it up I was told that I could not buy it, I asked why?  I was told that the company manager blocked my company from buying, because I am reselling Hayward products.  I want to report here that I don't recommend it, I went through a lot of embarrassment and financial loss due to this Hayward pump I tried to buy, my lawyer read the contract about the company's rules and checked the laws of the state of Texas and the country.  I have the right to buy all the products that are available from this company, there is no trademark restriction clause, my lawyer is taking care of suing this company in the court house for several things, what they did is a crime!

I sent email asking answer and nobody answer

I will report to all company owner friends not to buy from this company
reviews.author: Gleidson Azevedo

reviews.text:
horrible service, dont answer the phone

incorrect hours listed. they are NOT open saturdays, wasted my time and im sure plenty of others
reviews.author: Chance Turner

data.summary: Reviews show signs of authenticity in complaint details and varied writing, but the low volume and polarized nature (mostly 5-star and 1-star) are concerning. Several 5-star reviews read as defensive responses to common complaints rather than organic praise. The business appears to be a wholesale supplier with policies that frustrate retail consumers, leading to genuine negative experiences.
fake_signals: Low total review volume (17) increases susceptibility to manipulation
Strategic sample shows polarized 5-star and 1-star reviews with few mid-range
Some 5-star reviews (e.g., Jim Jones) defensively address common complaints, potentially inauthentic
authentic_signals: Specific details in complaints (locations, brand policies, staff names)
Varied writing styles and specific scenarios in negative reviews
Positive reviews mention specific employees and locations
BBB accreditation and A+ rating suggest formal complaint resolution
complaint_patterns: Not selling to consumers/reseller policy confusion
data.discrepancy_explanation: Limited rating data. BBB A+ is positive but reflects complaint handling, not service quality. No Yelp or other consumer review ratings for direct comparison.
